topics.why: the mix-up is naming an angle with its vertex not in the middle (BAC for ABC); the lighthouse has no lettered points
topics.needs: lettered points (A, B, C) on the arms and vertex, and a round where the child names or picks the angle by its letters

topics.why: the mix-up is lining up the protractor's bottom edge instead of its centre on the vertex; the engine always draws the scale centred
topics.needs: a protractor the child places (drag and rotate) on a drawn angle, read where she put it

topics.why: the mix-up is reading a tally bundle of 5 as 4 (counting only the standing lines); pictograph draws bars and pictures, no tally marks
topics.needs: tally marks (bundles of 4 standing lines and a crossing fifth) as a row or bar the child reads and counts

topics.why: sort-storm's keys are the bins an item belongs in; for this topic (segment, line, ray) the model makes up its own bins ('Khaana 1', 'Khaana 2') and cites unrelated kit items, so no key can be verified (refused unverified_key in regeneration rounds 1 and 2, 4 attempts)
topics.needs: a computed-key sort: items whose class the engine derives from the drawing itself (two endpoints = segment, one = ray, none = line), or a Games mode that does the same

topics.why: the mix-up is measuring from the ruler's edge or 1, or reading only the end number (an object from 3 to 9 called 9 cm); instrument's cut always starts at 0, so reading the end number is never wrong (judge A, regeneration round 3)
topics.needs: an object laid on the ruler off zero (from 3 to 9), read as end minus start

topics.why: the mix-up is that a right angle turned on its side is not a right angle; the lighthouse always draws one arm flat, so it cannot show a tilted angle (regeneration round 3 asked 90° every time)
topics.needs: an angle whose base arm the engine can turn to any direction, and a round that sorts tilted angles by kind

topics.why: the mix-up is about checking a corner against a folded paper corner (a near-right angle that seems to fit is called right); the lighthouse has no paper-corner tool and the same flat base arm (regeneration rounds 1b and 3)
topics.needs: a fold-a-corner square tester the child lays on a drawn corner, showing the gap when the angle is not 90°
